nodes.label: 1-to-10 Repurposing Framework
nodes.rationale: Workflow to repurpose a single long-form content item (blog/video) into 10 platform-specific social posts over 2 weeks.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Pricing Model (Good-Better-Best)
nodes.rationale: Pricing psychology model using Good-Better-Best anchoring to nudge clients towards middle tier.

nodes.label: Google E-E-A-T Quality Framework
nodes.rationale: Google evaluation criteria assessing Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness.

nodes.label: Value-Trust-Offer (70/20/10) Nurture Rule
nodes.rationale: Nurture mix rule: 70% value, 20% soft positioning, 10% direct offer to convert leads.

nodes.label: Loop Engineering (Ralph Pattern)
nodes.rationale: Closed-loop automation where agent runs isolated checks, records results in physical state files, and continues until verified.

nodes.label: Feature-Centric Clean Architecture
nodes.rationale: Next.js architecture separating Concerns into Core (business), Feature (modules), Application (services/hooks), Infrastructure (Supabase), and Presentation (App Router/Atomic UI).

nodes.label: React Hook Sync Effect Lint Rule
nodes.rationale: Constraint warning against calling setState synchronously in useEffect, which triggers cascading renders.

nodes.rationale: Displays the visual brand identity of the PetNova platform, featuring a glowing star (nova) above silhouettes of a dog, bird, rabbit, and cat in a circular cosmic badge.

nodes.label: PetNova Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Represents the core domain (diverse animal care: canine, feline, avian, lagomorph) aligned under a modern, luminous, and innovative brand theme represented by a guiding cosmic star (Nova).
